news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 2 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 2 independent directors. 3 non-independent directors. Independent Director Akthar Begum was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2024. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹2.40 loss per share (vs ₹2.07 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹2.40 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹2.07 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹5.61m (down 27% from 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹12.0m (loss widened 16% from 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 8% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 22% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.
